name: csharp-game-editor
description: Change the real project in your open Unity editor from Hermes after reading the plan and approving once, on MCP for Unity (CoplayDev/unity-mcp) 10.3.0. Disk reads of .unity, .prefab, .asset, and .cs text run at once. An editor read and every change come back as a plan from plan_batch and run with apply_plan after one Hermes approval; a plan that deletes, runs editor code, or saves over unsaved work asks once more. apply_plan copies what it touches and puts back a file the plan did not name. A .meta stays when its asset or folder was already on disk. A Unity .meta whose asset is already missing is named in the plan, and Unity's change to it is kept.
